overall_summary: The channel's highest-performing content heavily centers around complex husband-wife/relationship dynamics and unspoken emotional realities (e.g., 'Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?' with 1,767 views and 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए' with 1,674 views). General relationship advice and heavy poetic shayari perform significantly lower, indicating the audience prefers grounded domestic and emotional relationship psychology over abstract poetry.

winning_patterns.evidence: Top videos like 'Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?' (1,767 views) and 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए' (1,674 views) outperform all other topics by a huge margin.
winning_patterns.action: Produce more narrative-driven shorts exploring post-marriage silent struggles, emotional disconnect, and couple psychology.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'Har Baar Sorry Bolne Wala Galat Nahi Hota' received solid engagement (385 views) compared to generic shayari.
winning_patterns.action: Frame hooks around universal relationship compromises and silent emotional burdens.

weak_patterns.evidence: 'जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा… रिश्तों को षड्यंत्र लिखूंगा' generated only 19 views.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid heavy, abstract, or overly poetic titles that lack a clear everyday human situation.

weak_patterns.pattern: Niche Family Relations with Low Hook Power
weak_patterns.evidence: Certain family shorts like the sister emotional video ('बहन सिर्फ घर की रौनक होती है') stalled at 19 views.
weak_patterns.action: Ensure family-centric hooks focus on a specific unspoken tension rather than generic praise.
